questions.feedbackCorrect: Correct — division becomes subtraction, powers become multipliers.
questions.feedbackWrong: Log of a quotient subtracts: $\log x^2 - \log y = 2\log x - \log y$.

mistakes.misconception: Applies the power rule to the whole expression instead of the numerator.
mistakes.correction: The power 2 belongs to x only: separate the fraction first, THEN apply power rules.

mistakes.misconception: Treats log of a quotient as a quotient of logs.
mistakes.correction: $\log(x/y)$ is the DIFFERENCE of logs, never their ratio — a very different thing.

questions.prompt: Solve $5^x = 17$, giving x to 3 significant figures.

A population of bacteria grows according to $N = 500e^{0.4t}$ where t is in hours. Explain the meaning of each constant, and calculate the time for the population to reach 10000, showing the logarithm step.

markScheme.text: 500 is the INITIAL population (value at t = 0, since e⁰ = 1).
0.4 is the continuous growth rate per hour — 40% continuous growth.

mistakes.misconception: Treats the growth as simple multiplication of rate and initial value.
mistakes.correction: Growth compounds continuously — the model is exponential in t, so inverting it requires logarithms.

questions.feedbackWrong: The inverse function of $e^x$ is the natural logarithm — they undo each other.

mistakes.misconception: Confuses the inverse function with the reciprocal.
mistakes.correction: $f^{-1}$ undoes f — it is NOT 1/f. The reciprocal of $e^x$ is $e^{-x}$, a different object entirely.

questions.prompt: Explain why $f(x) = x^2$ with domain all real numbers does not have an inverse function, and how the domain can be restricted so that it does.

markScheme.text: A function must be one-to-one for an inverse to exist — inverse must map each output to exactly one input.
$x^2$ is many-to-one: both $x$ and $-x$ give the same output, so an inverse would be ambiguous.
Restricting the domain to $x \ge 0$ (or $x \le 0$) makes it one-to-one, and the inverse becomes $\sqrt{x}$.

questions.feedbackWrong: Modulus equations split into two cases: 2x − 3 = 5 and 2x − 3 = −5, giving x = 4 and x = −1.

mistakes.correction: The modulus equation |A| = k (k>0) always has TWO branches: A = k and A = −k.

questions.prompt: The value of a car is modelled by $V = 20000e^{-0.15t}$ after t years. Describe the long-term behaviour and calculate the value after 5 years.

markScheme.text: As $t \to \infty$, $V \to 0$ — exponential decay approaches zero but never reaches it; the model becomes unrealistic for very old cars.
